title: Geometry - Lesson 2 Practice: Angle Names and Measures
description: Practice naming angles, identifying vertices, classifying angle measures, and writing complete angle statements.

questions.question: In $\angle ABC$, the vertex is point ______.
questions.explanation: In a three-letter angle name, the middle letter is the vertex.

questions.question: Which statement is a complete angle measure statement?
questions.explanation: A complete measure statement uses m∠, the angle name, an equals sign, and degrees.

questions.question: An angle measuring $42^\circ$ is classified as what type of angle?
questions.explanation: An acute angle is greater than 0° and less than 90°.

questions.question: An angle measuring $128^\circ$ is classified as what type of angle?
questions.explanation: 128° is greater than 90° and less than 180°, so it is obtuse.

questions.question: $\angle ABC$ and $m\angle ABC$ mean exactly the same thing.
questions.explanation: ∠ABC names the angle. m∠ABC means the measure of the angle.

questions.question: Write the measure only: A right angle measures ______ degrees.
Rays $\overrightarrow{DE}$ and $\overrightarrow{DF}$ form an angle. Name the angle using three letters.
questions.correctAnswer: The angle can be named angle EDF or angle FDE because D is the vertex.
questions.explanation: Both rays start at D, so D must be the middle letter.

questions.question: Write a complete angle statement for angle XYZ if its measure is 105 degrees.
questions.explanation: The complete statement names the angle and gives its measure in degrees.
